spec.rawSql: select last(level, time) as level from data_vehicle_energy_level where vehicle_id = 1;
select autonomy as range from data_vehicle_energy_autonomy where vehicle_id = 1 order by time desc limit 1;

spec.description:
Level: the battery level in percent the car last reported.

Range: the remaining range in km the car estimates for that level. It depends on the recent driving and the temperature, so it moves without the level changing.

Both are the newest values the collector stored; it reads the car controller's cached status every 5 minutes.
spec.title: Battery Level

payload.rawSql:
update
  settings_config
set
  value = case key
    when 'goesignaller_enable' then '${payload.value}'
    when 'charging_mode' then '${payload.charging_mode}'
    when 'charging_threshold' then '${payload.charging_threshold}'
    when 'grid_import_limit_kw' then '${payload.grid_import_limit_kw}'
    when 'grid_import_alert_kw' then '${payload.grid_import_alert_kw}'
    when 'grid_import_raise_margin_kw' then '${payload.grid_import_raise_margin_kw}'
  end
where
  key in ('goesignaller_enable', 'charging_mode', 'charging_threshold', 'grid_import_limit_kw', 'grid_import_alert_kw', 'grid_import_raise_margin_kw');

spec.rawSql: SELECT day_of_week, coalesce(to_char(journey_start, 'HH24:MI'), 'None') as journey_start, load_to_full FROM settings_charging_plan WHERE day_of_week = $weekday

confirmModal.body: Please confirm to update changed values
confirmModal.title: Confirm update request

payload.rawSql:
update
  settings_charging_plan
set
  load_to_full = ${payload.load_to_full},
  journey_start = (select case when '${payload.journey_start}' = 'None' then null else '${payload.journey_start}' end)::time without time zone
where
  day_of_week = ${payload.day_of_week};

spec.description: Starts (frc 2, force on) or stops (frc 1, force off) charging on the go-e charger at once. The automatic charging control may undo it within 5 minutes.
spec.title: Charging

spec.description: The charger's last reading, taken by the collector every 5 s and read from Prometheus, so refreshing the dashboard doesn't call the charger. Empty when the collector has had no answer from the charger for 60 s. Phases and Current are what the go-e is set to, Setting is phases × 230 V × current. After pressing a button or changing the charging mode the new values show within about 10 s.
spec.title: Charger (live)

spec.rawSql: select last(time, time) as time from data_vehicle_energy_level where vehicle_id = 1;

spec.description: When the collector last stored a battery level, in Vienna time. It reads the car controller's cached status every 5 minutes, and the controller refreshes it from the Stellantis API every 2 minutes, so the time is the collector's run, not when the car itself last sent data. If it is more than about 5 minutes old, the collector or the car controller has stopped delivering.
spec.title: Last Update

spec.rawSql: SELECT last(status, time) as preconditioning from data_vehicle_preconditioning;
SELECT last(status, time) as charging from data_vehicle_charging_status;
SELECT last(status, time) as ignition_status from data_vehicle_ignition_status;

spec.description:
What the car last reported to the Stellantis API, read by the collector every 5 minutes.

Preconditioning: whether the air conditioning is preconditioning the car (Enabled or Disabled).

Charging: the car's charging state, e.g. InProgress, Stop, Finished or Disconnected. Connected means the cable is plugged in but the car is not charging.

Ignition Status: StartUp while the car is switched on, Stop when it is off.
spec.title: Car status

spec.expr: round(((clamp_min(95 - vehicle_battery_level_percent, 0) * 0.5 / (avg_over_time(power_goe_watts[2m]) / 1000) + (100 - clamp_min(vehicle_battery_level_percent, 95)) * 0.5 / clamp_max(avg_over_time(power_goe_watts[2m]) / 1000, 2.5)) * 3600 and avg_over_time(power_goe_watts[2m]) > 500), 60) or on() vector(-1)

spec.description:
Power: what the go-e delivers right now, from the collector's last reading (see Charger (live)). The markers are the steps of the charging modes: 2.3 kW slow, 6.9 kW balanced, 11 kW fast.

Time to full: an estimate from the battery level and the charging power of the last 2 minutes, with the same model as the charging control (50 kWh battery, 0.5 kWh per percent, the last 5 % at no more than 2.5 kW), without its 15-minute safety margin. The car reports its level only every 5 minutes, so the estimate falls in steps. Shows – while the go-e delivers less than 0.5 kW.
spec.title: Charging power

spec.rawSql:
select bucket as time, last_val(mileage) as mileage from agg_15m_counter_data_vehicle_mileage where vehicle_id = 1 
and $__timeFilter(bucket) order by bucket

spec.description: Odometer in km, as the car reports it. The sparkline shows this week.
spec.title: Mileage

spec.description: State of health of the traction battery in percent. The car reports it to the Stellantis API as the battery resistance health (battery.health.resistance), not as a capacity measurement. psa_car_controller stores it whenever it records a charge, and the collector reads the latest value every 5 minutes. The panel shows that last recorded value, so it changes only after a new charge is recorded.
spec.title: Battery SOH

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, air_temp
FROM data_vehicle_environment_airtemp 
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)

spec.description: Outside air temperature measured by the car, as it last reported it. The sparkline shows today.
spec.title: Air Temp
